about_the_game:
6 ways to 7  is a high-stakes roguelike twist on the classic dice game Craps! It combines the hard choices of a roguelike, with the push your luck gameplay of craps.

Your goal? Hit the target score each round to progress through increasingly difficult levels. But the dice aren't your only weapon—between rounds, visit the shop to buy powerful, rule-bending chips, game-breaking upgrades, and bizarre power-ups that twist the odds in your favor (or against you). Stack multipliers, manipulate rolls, and create wild combos as you push your luck to the limit!

Can you outplay the house, build the ultimate dice-slinging strategy, and make it to the final level? Roll the dice and find out!

  • Classic craps gameplay

  • Scaling difficulty to challenge experience roguelike players

  • Over 70 special chips with unique abilities

  • Over 15 NPCs who will help or hinder your strategy

  • 10 Special dice to push the odds in your favor

  • Addicting gameplay and tons of dopamine
